test_runs.scope: small synthetic rotation, role-gate and indicator-evaluator tests only

validation_runs.command: .venv/bin/python -m py_compile src/facecheck/rotation_control.py src/facecheck/platform_api.py src/facecheck/platform_catalog.py scripts/evaluate_indicators.py tests/test_rotation_control.py tests/test_indicator_evaluation.py

checks: SQLite queue creates durable rotation plans and claims with retry state
verified target publication is followed by transactional SQLite object reference and manifest anchor switch with audit event
stale source references fail compare-and-swap and remain unswitched
worker restart can reuse and verify a deterministic target published before interruption
legacy v1 is re-encrypted to v2; v2 recipient-key rotation rewraps the envelope
configured feature cache is invalidated and unresolved source/backup artifacts block revocation
hidden staging entries and v1 rows without key_id fail closed in inventory and reference checks
duplicate source key rotation plans are rejected
administrator-only rotation routes reject auditor access
indicator evaluator reports the prototype as partial and does not claim 100 percent old-key invalidation
limitations: rewrap changes the recipient envelope but does not replace exposed per-video key material; key compromise requires full data re-encryption
v1 to v2 migration temporarily materializes plaintext in a restricted staging directory; forced termination can leave staging data
writer fencing, reader drain and external backup completeness require operator/deployment attestations and are not enforced across nodes
SQLite and object storage do not share an atomic transaction; deterministic target publication supports recovery but is a local saga prototype
no real KMS/HSM revocation call or complete external backup and disaster-recovery inventory was exercised
scope_note: Small synthetic functional evidence only. It does not prove production key management, global revocation, scale, or the 100 percent old-key invalidation target. Formal recognition and throughput results are unchanged.
